PAYLOAD_URL="https://publish.xencolabs.com"

declare -A CATS=(
  ["ITAD Compliance"]="itad-compliance"
  ["Data Destruction"]="data-destruction"
  ["Data Center"]="data-center"
  ["Healthcare ITAD"]="healthcare-itad"
  ["Financial Services"]="financial-services"
  ["Government & Defense"]="government-defense"
  ["Value Recovery"]="value-recovery"
  ["Sustainability & ESG"]="sustainability-esg"
  ["Reverse Logistics"]="reverse-logistics"
  ["Industry News"]="industry-news"
)

for TITLE in "ITAD Compliance" "Data Destruction" "Data Center" "Healthcare ITAD" "Financial Services" "Government & Defense" "Value Recovery" "Sustainability & ESG" "Reverse Logistics" "Industry News"; do
  SLUG="${CATS[$TITLE]}"

    -H "Authorization: API-Key $API_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "{\"title\":\"$TITLE\",\"slug\":\"$SLUG\",\"site\":$SITE_ID}")

```bash
cd /home/xen/docker/apps/payload-swarm/docs/aer-47-blog

# Create all 10 categories for site 47
PAYLOAD_URL="https://publish.xencolabs.com"

declare -A CATS=(
  ["ITAD Compliance"]="itad-compliance"

  ["Government & Defense"]="government-defense"
  ["Value Recovery"]="value-recovery"
  ["Sustainability & ESG"]="sustainability-esg"
  ["Reverse Logistics"]="reverse-logistics"
  ["Industry News"]="industry-news"
)

for TITLE in "ITAD Compliance" "Data Destruction" "Data Center" "Healthcare ITAD" "Financial Services" "Government & Defense" "Value Recovery" "Sustainability & ESG" "Reverse Logistics" "Industry News"; do
  SLUG="${CATS[$TITLE]}"
